course.name: Medicine MB BChir
course.notes: Standard-entry Medicine with three pre-clinical Cambridge years and three clinical years. The supplied research records an OfS maximum fundable limit of 291 Home and 22 overseas medical places across Cambridge medicine routes; A101 and affiliated graduate routes are separate or manual-review boundaries for this A100 profile.

medical_school.name: School of Clinical Medicine, University of Cambridge

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Home applicants are reviewed holistically by college using academic record, UCAT cognitive total, reference, My Cambridge Application and contextual information.
International applicants are considered in a separate, centrally moderated competition under the small overseas medicine quota.

overall_policy.description: Cambridge A100 requires UCAS by 15 October, My Cambridge Application, UCAT cognitive total, Chemistry plus at least one further science/maths subject and published post-16 grade requirements before holistic college review.
not_eligible_if: Chemistry is absent from A Level or equivalent science requirements.
No Biology, Physics or Mathematics subject is present alongside Chemistry.
The standard A*A*A or equivalent academic gate is not met, except for contextual A*AA cases requiring manual review.
International English-language requirements are not met where required.
Applicant is under 18 at course start when age evidence is supplied.

gcse.notes: No formal GCSE requirements and no GCSE points score. GCSE profile is used only as a modelled ApplySmart competitiveness modifier, with school context considered qualitatively.

subject_combination_rule.notes: Most colleges prefer Chemistry plus two further science/maths subjects; this is recorded as guidance rather than a universal eligibility gate.

a_level.notes: Standard Medicine offers are not reduced contextually. Some colleges specify where A* grades must fall; this cannot be applied generically and remains an applicant-facing college-check warning.

international_baccalaureate.notes: HL Chemistry plus one or two of Biology, Physics and Mathematics depending on college. ApplySmart implements Chemistry plus at least one further science/maths HL route.

scottish.advanced_higher_offer: A1, A1, A2 including Chemistry and the same science/maths subject rules as A Level.
scottish.notes: A1/A2 Advanced Higher precision is not represented in the current generic grade-rank engine, so Scottish profiles require manual review unless entered as equivalent A-level-style evidence.

graduate.accepted_route: Graduates may apply through standard A100 or affiliated A100 entry at Lucy Cavendish, St Edmund's or Wolfson. A101 is separate.
graduate.notes: Graduate route, college restrictions and science coverage require manual review for this A100 profile.

post_16.notes: International country-specific qualification equivalency is not executable without verified qualification evidence.

ucat.notes: UCAT is required for A100 and Cambridge publishes no fixed cut-off.

sjt.notes: SJT is not used at all for Cambridge A100 shortlisting in the supplied 2027-entry research.

resits.policy: No formal ban, but resits without documented extenuating circumstances substantially weaken the application and require manual review.

english_language.notes: Applies where English-language evidence is required, especially international applicants.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Students must be 18 by the start of the course; DBS, occupational health, immunisation and fitness-to-practise checks apply after offer/admission.

ranking_factors.notes: Central to holistic review but not converted into a published score.
UCAT cognitive total is considered alongside academic evidence. SJT is ignored.
Contextual indicators inform judgement; they are not a numeric Cambridge bonus.

total_score.notes: Cambridge has no published points-based shortlisting formula. ApplySmart uses hidden modelled bands for interview guidance only.

calculation.notes: Modelled ApplySmart configuration lives in data/interview-band-configs/cambridge-a100.json. It must not be described as a Cambridge score.

selection_adjustments.notes: Qualitative contextual uplift; no reduced Medicine offer and no official points bonus.

tie_breakers.notes: No numeric tie-breaker is published. Close decisions use admissions judgement and the winter pool.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Cambridge does not publish a score, fixed UCAT cut-off or guarantee. Internal thresholds are modelled and hidden from applicants.

adjustments.notes: Contextual information informs judgement but does not reduce the published Medicine offer.

contextual_admissions.notes: No separate contextual pool or quota and no reduced contextual Medicine offer.

ranking_pools.name: Cambridge A100 Home holistic pool
ranking_pools.notes: OfS Home medical maximum fundable limit applies across Cambridge medicine routes, not solely A100.

ranking_pools.name: Cambridge A100 International holistic pool
ranking_pools.notes: OfS overseas quota is small and shared across Cambridge medicine routes; international outcomes require adviser review even where modelled guidance is available.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.
OfS anticipated Home places from 2025-26 onwards, shared across the university medical intake.
OfS anticipated overseas places, shared across A100 and A101.

offer_selection.interview_format: One or two panel interviews, generally science-focused, held in December with possible pool interviews in January.
offer_selection.interview_scoring: College-specific holistic judgement; no ApplySmart offer modelling.
offer_selection.offer_model: College decision moderated by the winter pool. Offer-stage prediction is out of scope.
offer_selection.waiting_list_policy: No conventional reserve/waiting list; the winter pool redistributes strong applicants between colleges.
offer_selection.standard_offer: A*A*A including Chemistry plus at least one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics, with college-specific variations.
offer_selection.notes: Offer prediction is unavailable and must not be implemented.

cycles.notes: Headline applications and offers from the supplied research. UCAT means are retained in research/config metadata and are not rendered as cut-offs.

historical_admissions.notes: Cambridge publishes no interview cut-off. 2025 Home and International offer-holder UCAT means and modelled 2026/pre-2025 converted figures are historical calibration inputs only.

sources.title: ApplySmart Cambridge A100 Master Research v2-2
sources.notes: User-supplied authoritative research document for this implementation.

sources.title: Cambridge A100 Engine JSON
sources.notes: Used as reference only. Authoritative policy source remains the Cambridge research document.

known_unknowns: College-specific A* placement and additional science/maths preferences vary and are not executable generically.
Scottish A1/A2 Advanced Higher precision is not represented in the generic grade-rank engine.
International country-specific qualification equivalency requires verified applicant evidence.
Cambridge publishes no official interview cut-off or score formula.
validation.review_notes: Implemented Cambridge A100 interview guidance as hidden modelled bands after official eligibility gates. Offer prediction remains out of scope.

engine_assumptions: The supplied research document is authoritative.
Cambridge Engine JSON is reference-only and not copied directly where it conflicts with the research.
Strong and Borderline Cambridge research labels are mapped onto existing ApplySmart canonical bands for runtime compatibility.
do_not_infer: Do not expose internal UCAT boundaries or modelled score thresholds to applicants.
Do not treat modelled bands as Cambridge-published cut-offs.
Do not use SJT for Cambridge A100 interview selection.
Do not auto-evaluate non-standard overseas qualifications without verified equivalency evidence.
standardisation_drift: Research labels five bands, including Strong and Borderline; ApplySmart runtime exposes existing canonical bands only. Strong maps conservatively into realistic guidance and Borderline maps to ambitious.
